output.headline: UPMC has closed all three of its deals in the target's own sub-sector and has US$27.7 billion of revenue to fund a $200M acquisition.
output.differentiator: All 3 of its deals are in the target's own sub-sector and all closed. Peer lines were not available, so no lead over other buyers is claimed.
output.why_them: Own-sub-sector buyer with a clean closing record and scale

acquirer_overview.title: A scaled provider system with a fully closed deal record
points: Revenue US$27.7 billion (2023). Hospitals in Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York; Washington Health System merged with UPMC in 2024 [P:1, P:2].
Three control deals between 2018 and 2020, all closed [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Ranks 3rd on the priority list of 10, with a likelihood of 4.7% across 107 buyers scored [R:rank].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Same sub-sector as the target, the strongest factor in its likelihood
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor; target margin close to what it usually buys is a strong factor [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit].
All 3 deals were in Healthcare Services, with none in adjacent provider sub-sectors [K:by_sub_sector, T:record].
Platform Build is a motive in 1 of 3 deals (Principal Behavioral Health bolt-on), consistent with treating the target as an add-on [M:platform_build, D:MA-2019-0090].

precedent_activity.title: Three closed sub-sector deals, none in the Midwest or at this size
points: Principal Behavioral Health: $444M bolt-on acquisition, 2019, 11.7x EV/EBITDA, Northeast [D:MA-2019-0090].
Sterling Care Network: $55M strategic acquisition, 2020, 11.3x. Keystone Behavioral Health: $33M recapitalization, 2018, 17.0x [D:MA-2020-0312, D:MA-2018-0486].
0 of 3 deals fall in the $100M-$400M size band, and 0 are in the target's region [K:size_band, T:record].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible but above UPMC's usual multiple
points: 70 comparable deals: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th percentile; 9 are in the same sub-sector [V:comps].
The target's 16.8% margin beats the comps' median of 12.9% and sits above 87% of comps, which supports the 75th percentile [V:comps].
UPMC's median multiple paid is 11.7x. Synergy headroom of $15M-$25M and US$27.7 billion of revenue show capacity to pay up [V:comps, V:synergy, P:1].

risk_flags.title: Quiet since 2020
risk_flags.concern: No deals since 2022; its last deal was in 2020 [K:recent, T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: The 2024 Washington Health System merger shows it is still combining with other systems [P:2].
risk_flags.reality: Recent activity is only a slight factor against, outweighed by sub-sector share [S:recency, S:sector_share].

risk_flags.title: Price gap to the 75th percentile
risk_flags.concern: Its median multiple paid of 11.7x is below the 15.3x 75th percentile [V:comps].
risk_flags.mitigant: It paid 17.0x for Keystone, and synergy headroom is $15M-$25M [D:MA-2018-0486, V:synergy].
risk_flags.reality: An upper-quartile bid stretches beyond its usual range, though it has paid more before [V:comps].

risk_flags.title: Unproven in the Midwest and at this size
risk_flags.concern: No deals in the target's region and none in the $100M-$400M band [T:record, K:size_band].
risk_flags.mitigant: It has completed a $444M deal and a national deal, and has US$27.7 billion of revenue [D:MA-2019-0090, P:1].
risk_flags.reality: Region and size are untested for UPMC, so a Midwest integration is a first [K:by_region].

conviction.rationale: Three deals in the target's own sub-sector and none in adjacent provider sub-sectors; no deal in the target's region is neutral; it remains among the three highest-scored buyers after review (#3) [C:conviction].
